title: Italian-Style Eggplant with Baba Ganoush
description: A flavorful and healthy Italian-inspired eggplant dish with a twist of Middle Eastern baba ganoush. Perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1/2-inch thick slices.
Brush both sides of the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Roast the eggplant in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, heat the baba ganoush in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic to the baba ganoush and stir to combine.
Once the eggplant is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the roasted eggplant with the baba ganoush sauce spooned over the top, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
